batch_item_request.name: batch_item_request
batch_item_request.value: "batch_items"."status" <> 'scheduled' OR ("batch_items"."request_id" IS NOT NULL AND "batch_items"."requested_revision" IS NOT NULL)

download_run_input.name: download_run_input
download_run_input.value: "download_runs"."status" NOT IN ('pending', 'in_progress') OR "download_runs"."input" IS NOT NULL

download_run_lease.name: download_run_lease
download_run_lease.value: ("download_runs"."status" = 'in_progress') = ("download_runs"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "download_runs"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

download_run_alias.name: download_run_alias
download_run_alias.value: ("download_runs"."status" = 'superseded') = ("download_runs"."canonical_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("download_runs"."canonical_id" IS NULL OR "download_runs"."canonical_id" <> "download_runs"."id")

import_request_item.name: import_request_item
import_request_item.value: "import_requests"."status" NOT IN ('pending', 'approved') OR "import_requests"."item" IS NOT NULL

import_request_alias.name: import_request_alias
import_request_alias.value: ("import_requests"."status" = 'superseded') = ("import_requests"."canonical_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("import_requests"."canonical_id" IS NULL OR "import_requests"."canonical_id" <> "import_requests"."id")

uq_jobs_active_thumbnail.name: uq_jobs_active_thumbnail
uq_jobs_active_thumbnail.where:
"jobs"."type" = 'generate_thumbnail'
					AND "jobs"."status" IN ('pending', 'in_progress')
					AND "jobs"."source_id" IS NOT NULL

media_processing_scheduled_owner.name: media_processing_scheduled_owner
media_processing_scheduled_owner.value: "media_processing_states"."execution_mode" <> 'scheduled' OR ("media_processing_states"."scheduled_input" IS NOT NULL AND "media_processing_states"."owner_job_id" IS NULL AND "media_processing_states"."owner_attempt_count" IS NULL AND "media_processing_states"."attempt_count" <= "media_processing_states"."max_attempts")

media_processing_claim.name: media_processing_claim
media_processing_claim.value: ("media_processing_states"."status" = 'in_progress' AND "media_processing_states"."claim_token" IS NOT NULL AND "media_processing_states"."claimed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "media_processing_states"."heartbeat_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("media_processing_states"."status" <> 'in_progress' AND "media_processing_states"."claim_token" IS NULL AND "media_processing_states"."claimed_at" IS NULL AND "media_processing_states"."heartbeat_at" IS NULL)

media_processing_owner.name: media_processing_owner
media_processing_owner.value: ("media_processing_states"."owner_job_id" IS NULL AND "media_processing_states"."owner_attempt_count" IS NULL) OR ("media_processing_states"."owner_job_id" IS NOT NULL AND "media_processing_states"."owner_attempt_count" IS NOT NULL AND "media_processing_states"."owner_attempt_count" >= 0)

media_regions_bbox_by_kind.name: media_regions_bbox_by_kind
media_regions_bbox_by_kind.value:
(
				("media_regions"."kind" = 'full' AND "media_regions"."x" IS NULL AND "media_regions"."y" IS NULL AND "media_regions"."width" IS NULL AND "media_regions"."height" IS NULL)
				OR
				("media_regions"."kind" <> 'full' AND "media_regions"."x" IS NOT NULL AND "media_regions"."y" IS NOT NULL AND "media_regions"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "media_regions"."height" IS NOT NULL
					AND "media_regions"."x" >= 0 AND "media_regions"."y" >= 0 AND "media_regions"."width" > 0 AND "media_regions"."height" > 0
					AND "media_regions"."x" + "media_regions"."width" <= 1 AND "media_regions"."y" + "media_regions"."height" <= 1)
			)

source_owner_lease.name: source_owner_lease
source_owner_lease.value: ("source_run_leases"."token" IS NULL AND "source_run_leases"."run_id" IS NULL AND "source_run_leases"."expires_at" IS NULL AND "source_run_leases"."kind" IS NULL) OR ("source_run_leases"."token" IS NOT NULL AND "source_run_leases"."run_id" IS NOT NULL AND "source_run_leases"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_run_leases"."kind" IS NOT NULL)

sync_run_input.name: sync_run_input
sync_run_input.value: "source_sync_runs"."status" IN ('blocked','failed','completed','cancelled') OR ("source_sync_runs"."input" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("source_sync_runs"."input") = 'object' AND coalesce("source_sync_runs"."input"->>'kind' = 'sync', false) AND "source_sync_runs"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)

transfer_run_input.name: transfer_run_input
transfer_run_input.value: "source_transfer_runs"."status" IN ('blocked','failed','completed','cancelled') OR ("source_transfer_runs"."input" IS NOT NULL AND jsonb_typeof("source_transfer_runs"."input") = 'object' AND coalesce("source_transfer_runs"."input"->>'kind' = "source_transfer_runs"."kind", false) AND "source_transfer_runs"."source_id" IS NOT NULL)
